steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: There are 10 components of fitness that you need to know for GCSE PE. They are divided into health-related and skill-related components.

steps.title: Definition
steps.body: The ability of the heart, lungs and blood vessels to deliver oxygen to working muscles over a prolonged period of time.

steps.title: Definition
steps.body: The ability of a muscle or group of muscles to sustain repeated contractions, or to continue applying force against a fixed object, over a period of time.

steps.title: Definition
steps.body: The range of movement possible at a joint.

steps.title: Try it yourself
steps.body: Define cardiovascular endurance and give a sporting example where it is the most important component. | Explain the difference between strength and power. | Define agility and give two sporting examples.

steps.title: Exam tips
steps.body: Learn ALL 10 definitions word-for-word - this is the most tested topic in PE Always link a component to a sporting example - don't just define it Power = Strength × Speed is a guaranteed formula question Know the difference between muscular endurance (repeated contractions over time) and strength (single maximal force) Agility involves CHANGING DIRECTION - don't confuse it with speed (moving in a straight line) Coordination = using two or more body parts together smoothly
